market_view: The market is in a risk-off regime with the index down about 2.6% and VIXY up 5.2%, so longs are half size and need high conviction. Spotify surged after Q3 earnings and is a clear catalyst, while CMCSA broke its opening range on high volume despite a Q4 restructuring charge. Broadly, the tape is weak, favoring shorting breakdowns, but selective names are showing intraday momentum.

decisions.reason: Closing the losing long to free a position slot and rotate into the best current setup; SONY failed to hold the opening range breakout with weak m15/m60 and downtrend.

CMCSA broke above the opening range on high volume (rvol 2.21) despite Q4 restructuring charge, showing demand; earnings beat but charge limits conviction, and risk-off calls for half size with conviction +1.
